#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, cost, rev;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, K, C, D;
    cin >> n >> m >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> a(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) cin >> a[i], a[i]--;
    vector<pair<int,int>> b(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) cin >> b[i].first >> b[i].second, b[i].first--, b[i].second--;
    int total_nodes = n * 105 + 2;
    int s = total_nodes - 2, t = total_nodes - 1;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph(total_nodes);
    auto add_edge = [&](int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[u].push_back({v, cap, cost, (int)graph[v].size()});
        graph[v].push_back({u, 0, -cost, (int)graph[u].size() - 1});
    };
    vector<vector<int>> id(n, vector<int>(105));
    int node_id = 0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
        for (int j=0; j<=100; ++j)
            id[i][j] = node_id++;
    for (int i=0; i<K; ++i)
        add_edge(s, id[a[i]][0], 1, 0);
    for (int i=0; i<=100; ++i)
        add_edge(id[0][i], t, K, C * i);
    for (int i=0; i<n; ++i)
        for (int j=0; j<100; ++j)
            add_edge(id[i][j], id[i][j+1], K, 0);
    for (auto &edge : b) {
        int x = edge.first, y = edge.second;
        for (int j=0; j<100; ++j) {
            for (int k=0; k<K; ++k) {
                add_edge(id[x][j], id[y][j+1], 1, D*(2*k+1));
                add_edge(id[y][j], id[x][j+1], 1, D*(2*k+1));
            }
        }
    }
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    vector<int> dist(total_nodes), potential(total_nodes, 0), parent_node(total_nodes), parent_edge(total_nodes);
    while (true) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), 1e9);
        dist[s] = 0;
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<>> pq;
        pq.push({0, s});
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (d > dist[u]) continue;
            for (int i=0; i<(int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                auto &e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to]) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                    parent_node[e.to] = u;
                    parent_edge[e.to] = i;
                    pq.push({dist[e.to], e.to});
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] == 1e9) break;
        for (int i=0; i<total_nodes; ++i)
            potential[i] += dist[i];
        int add_flow = 1e9;
        for (int u=t; u!=s; u=parent_node[u]) {
            add_flow = min(add_flow, graph[parent_node[u]][parent_edge[u]].capacity);
        }
        for (int u=t; u!=s; u=parent_node[u]) {
            auto &e = graph[parent_node[u]][parent_edge[u]];
            e.capacity -= add_flow;
            graph[u][e.rev].capacity += add_flow;
        }
        flow += add_flow;
        cost += add_flow * potential[t];
    }
    cout << cost << "\n";
    return 0;
}
